listing.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons (ACNHRecomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Animal Crossing: New Horizons native port based on Wonder, translating AArch64 main/sdk/subsdk0 code to C++ with Vulkan. The project reports the opening and island walking at 30 FPS on Ubuntu Linux x64 with Iris Xe. A full day and saving are unconfirmed; forcing 60 FPS doubles game speed, online play is unavailable and a bird-head rendering defect remains. There are no releases: the launcher/bash setup imports and builds locally. Windows setup requires Linux, Mac or WSL2 and does not provide a native Windows build pipeline; Android is unsupported. Apple Silicon MoltenVK scripts are untested. Supply your own base NSP and 3.0.2 update NSP for title 01006F8002326000, with prod.keys; title.keys is recommended and DLC is optional. The root guide requires no separate firmware folder; exact regional/build hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
